candidate_title: JANUS Resilient Edge Swarm: Modular Heterogeneous Sensor, Telemetry and Edge-Integration Network for Degraded Connectivity

primary_differentiator.name: MODULARITY_AND_EXTENSIBILITY
primary_differentiator.statement: JANUS is designed around heterogeneous role-preserving modules so new sensors, operator surfaces, compute devices, gateways, mobile platforms and other authorized edge modules can be added through bounded adapters without forcing every existing node into one hardware or firmware image.
primary_differentiator.current_evidence: heterogeneous existing firmware roles and developer-reported ten-node physical swarm
primary_differentiator.claim_ceiling: architecture/design property supported by current heterogeneity; not universal plug-and-play and not proof that arbitrary third-party platforms are already integrated
primary_differentiator.falsifiable_question: Can one new specialist be added while unrelated baseline nodes remain unchanged, and what exact ABI/configuration/resource cost does that require?

JUXTAPOSE.architecture: transport-agnostic exact-backed adaptive search for resilient communications
JUXTAPOSE.core_rule: learning may change authorized search order/width but fresh end-to-end measurement remains current connectivity authority
negative_lineage: v1 probe overhead and route thrashing preserved
v5 premature confidence in combined out-of-distribution regimes preserved
v5.1 repaired that specific novelty-confidence failure
independent end-to-end contribution of every submodule is not established in every setting
no independent external replication or field validation yet
JUXTAPOSE.xtech_use: demonstrate existing developer algorithmic/falsification capability and define an optional future physical validation path on the ten-node swarm
JUXTAPOSE.current_claim_ceiling: JUXTAPOSE synthetic evidence may motivate controlled hardware/network evaluation but is not JANUS hardware performance, field superiority, anti-jam capability, or current swarm integration

not_claimed: current integration into the JANUS xTech ten-node baseline
SkinGPT.xtech_use: demonstrate a separately implemented sensing subsystem that could be integrated as a future JANUS specialist module through the documented role/adapter contract

eligibility_reason.rfi_detailed_rule: small, for-profit, independent U.S. businesses with qualifying ownership/control and <=500 employees
eligibility_reason.webpage_conflict: summary field currently mentions small and large U.S.-based and allied foreign country businesses

primary_alignment: Command and Control (C2) and Counter-C2 Networks — resilient communications / deep sensing relevance
secondary_alignment: Adaptive Sustainment — distributed edge operations relevance
xtech_value_proposition: Evaluate the physically existing heterogeneous swarm as-is, with modularity and extensibility as the central architecture claim; freeze the real ten-node configuration, measure failure/recovery honestly, falsify the cost of adding one new benign module, and expose JUXTAPOSE and SkinGPT separately as already-developed adjacent capabilities rather than pretending they are already integrated.
